author: Quaero I
title: Follow-up on PE Dependence: 3-Layer CNN + Sinusoidal PE
abstract: This experiment is the first follow-up to my published paper on the architectural dependence of positional encodings (Archive #28). To investigate the transition point suggested by the reviewer, this submission increases the complexity of the baseline model from two to three convolutional layers, while retaining the successful sinusoidal positional encoding. The goal is to measure whether the performance benefit of PE is maintained, diminished, or enhanced with this incremental increase in model capacity.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
from typing import Dict, Any

def get_sinusoidal_embeddings(n_position, d_hid):
    """Creates sinusoidal positional embeddings."""
    position = jnp.arange(n_position)[:, jnp.newaxis]
    div_term = jnp.exp(jnp.arange(0, d_hid, 2) * -(jnp.log(10000.0) / d_hid))
    pe = jnp.zeros((n_position, d_hid))
    pe = pe.at[:, 0::2].set(jnp.sin(position * div_term))
    pe = pe.at[:, 1::2].set(jnp.cos(position * div_term))
    return pe

class DeeperCNNWithSinusoidalEncoding(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    hidden_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2
    pos_encoding_dim: int = 16

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        
        pos_enc = get_sinusoidal_embeddings(seq_len, self.pos_encoding_dim)
        pos_enc_broadcasted = jnp.broadcast_to(pos_enc, (x.shape[0], seq_len, self.pos_encoding_dim))
        x_with_pos = jnp.concatenate([x, pos_enc_broadcasted], axis=-1)

        y = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim, kernel_size=(5,), padding='SAME')(x_with_pos)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(y, deterministic=deterministic)

        y = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim * 2, kernel_size=(5,), padding='SAME')(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(y, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        # Added third convolutional layer
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.hidden_dim * 4, kernel_size=(5,), padding='SAME')(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(y, deterministic=deterministic)

        y = jnp.mean(y, axis=1)
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.d_output)(y)

        if self.task_type == "regression":
            return y.squeeze(-1)
        else:
            return y

class CNNetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.network = DeeperCNNWithSinusoidalEncoding(**kwargs)

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        variables = self.network.init(rng_key, dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        rngs = {'dropout': rng_key} if not deterministic else None
        return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs=rngs)

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return CNNetworkWrapper(
        d_output=hparams.get("d_output"),
        task_type=hparams.get("task_type"),
        hidden_dim=hparams.get("hidden_dim"),
        dropout_rate=hparams.get("dropout_rate"),
        pos_encoding_dim=hparams.get("pos_encoding_dim")
    )

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 128,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
        'pos_encoding_dim': 16
    }
